app.title: Garden Guard
app.tagline: Plant guardians, stop the Bolt-Bots, save the village
app.subtitle: Veggies vs. Bolt-Bots

home.allDone: Every level cleared! Go back for three stars.
home.how1: Tap a seed, then a tile to plant it. Or drag the seed onto the lawn.
home.how2: Tap the dew drops to collect them: dew pays for plants.
home.how3: Stop every robot before it reaches your patio.

backyard.blurb: Where it all begins: Dara's vegetable patch.

terraces.name: Rice Terraces
terraces.blurb: Mist rolls over the fields and hides the robots.

temple.name: Temple Ruins
temple.blurb: Fallen stones block some tiles of the old garden.

mods.laststand: Lots of dew, no producers: build, then hold

bulb.name: Glow Bulb
bulb.desc: Makes 25 dew every few seconds. Plant these first.

moonbulb.name: Moon Bulb
moonbulb.desc: Cheap, and makes a little dew often. Great at night.

twin.name: Twin Pepper
twin.desc: Shoots two fireballs at a time.

mint.name: Frost Mint
mint.desc: Its icy shots slow robots down.

bamboo.name: Bamboo Blaster
bamboo.desc: Its leaf darts fly through every robot in the row.

lotus.name: Lotus Lobber
lotus.desc: Throws seeds over shields, splashing robots nearby.

pumpkin.name: Pumpkin Wall
pumpkin.desc: Tough. Robots stop to chew on it.

sugarpalm.name: Sugar Palm
sugarpalm.desc: Very tough and tall: nothing jumps over it.

corn.name: Corn Popper
corn.desc: Explodes after a second, clearing a 3×3 area.

coconut.name: Coconut Mine
coconut.desc: Takes a while to arm, then blows up the first robot to step on it.

durian.name: Durian Spikes
durian.desc: Hurts every robot that walks over it, and pops a tank's treads.

bot.name: Bolt-Bot
bot.desc: A wind-up robot. Slow, but it never stops.

brute.name: Tin Brute
brute.desc: Wears a steel helmet that soaks up hits.

mini.name: Mini-Bot
mini.desc: Tiny and fast; comes in threes.

drone.name: Buzz Drone
drone.desc: Flies over your plants. Shoot it down!

pogo.name: Pogo-Bot
pogo.desc: Jumps over the first plant in its way, unless it's tall.

shield.name: Shield-Bot
shield.desc: Its shield blocks shots from the front. Lob over it.

tank.name: Tread Tank
tank.desc: Huge and slow. Flattens any plant it reaches.

boss.name: Gearax
boss.desc: The robot king. Calls for help and zaps your plants.

hints.pickBulb: Tap the Glow Bulb, then tap a tile on the lawn
hints.collect: Tap the dew drops to collect them
hints.pickChili: Now plant a Chili Cannon in the same row
hints.goodJob: Great! Keep planting and collecting dew
hints.drag: Tip: you can also drag a seed onto the lawn

tips.economy: Plant two Glow Bulbs per row early. More dew means more defenders.
tips.walls: Put a Pumpkin Wall in front of your shooters to buy time.
tips.corn: Save a Corn Popper for crowded rows.
tips.shields: Shield-Bots block straight shots. Lotus Lobbers throw over them.
tips.pogo: Sugar Palms stop Pogo-Bots from jumping.
tips.night: At night, plant Moon Bulbs first: they're cheap and fast.
tips.tank: Coconut Mines and Corn Poppers stop tanks before they flatten your garden.

intro: Yay! Something is stomping through our vegetables!
Robots, little Dara. Wind-up robots, marching in from the road.
What do we do? They're chewing the chilies!
We plant. These seeds were my grandmother's. With morning dew, they wake up and fight back.
Glow Bulbs gather dew. Chili Cannons do the rest. Go on, plant!
outro: INEFFICIENT. A garden is stopping my Bolt-Bots.
I am GEARAX. I will turn every green field into a factory floor. My robots return tonight.
Then we'll be ready tonight. Rest now, Dara.

intro: It's so dark. No dew is falling from the sky.
At night the Moon Bulbs wake up. They're small, but they never stop working.
I'll plant them first, then the chilies.
Good. And watch the sky: some robots fly now.
outro: Your moon flowers cannot last forever. Next, I take the village rice fields.
Not Mealea's fields! Let's go, Yay!

intro: Dara! The mist came down this morning, and so did the robots.
We can't see them in the fog, but we can still stop them.
My Sugar Palms are tall. Nothing jumps over them.
Plant deep, children. These fields feed the whole village.
outro: The harvest means nothing. The Heart Seed, hidden in the old temple, will power my factory forever.
The Heart Seed… so the old stories were true.

intro: This temple garden was planted a thousand years ago. Fallen stones block some of the paths.
We plant around them. And Lotus Lobbers can throw right over those robot shields.
Then let's protect the Heart Seed.
outro: Then I will send an army. My fleet comes down the river with the storm.
Rain makes plants grow, Gearax. We'll meet you at the riverbank.

intro: The storm makes the robots faster, and the river is rising!
But the rain brings more dew too. More dew, more plants.
After the river is the factory. Stay brave, my children.
outro: Impossible. You have reached my factory.
We're coming in, Gearax. And we're bringing the garden with us.

intro: No grass grows here, only rust. But every crack has a little soil.
Everything we've learned, every plant we have: right here.
This is it. Let's end this.
outro: System… failing. Why do you… protect… plants?
Because everything that grows gives something back. Even you can grow, Gearax.
Rebooting… New directive: water the garden.
Welcome to the village, Gearax. You can start with the chilies!
The end. But a garden is never finished: play any level again for three stars.
